title: Maria's Next Step
text:
Maria is a student at a university in Madrid. She studies English and computer science. She wants to work for an international company after she finishes her degree. Her teachers say she is very hardworking.

Next year, Maria will do an internship at a small technology company. The internship will last three months. She hopes to learn new skills and make useful contacts. Maria thinks this experience will help her find a good job.

questions.text: What does Maria study at the university?
How long will the internship last?
What can we infer about Maria's future plans?
options: She wants to work for an international company
She plans to stop studying after the internship
She will move to another country next month
She does not want a job in technology

questions.text: What can we infer about why Maria values the internship?
options: She believes it will help her get a good job
She expects to earn a high salary right away
It is the only requirement for her degree
It will allow her to skip her exams

vocabulary.definition: a school where students study after finishing high school
a period of time when a student works in a company to learn about a job
abilities that you learn and use to do something well
people you know who can help you in your career

paragraph_translations: María es estudiante en una universidad de Madrid. Estudia inglés e informática. Quiere trabajar en una empresa internacional después de terminar su carrera. Sus profesores dicen que es muy trabajadora.

El próximo año, María hará unas prácticas en una pequeña empresa de tecnología. Las prácticas durarán tres meses. Ella espera aprender nuevas habilidades y hacer contactos útiles. María piensa que esta experiencia la ayudará a encontrar un buen trabajo.
